trade_rules_of_thumb: Scale is 1-100 Superflex Half-PPR 10-team. Keep it every day. 90+ is 1.01-1.04, 75-89 late 1st/early 2nd, 55-74 is a 2nd.
Starting QBs are premium. A locked QB2 (Dak/TLaw/Purdy) beats a skill-player WR3 in this format.
Do not treat this like 1QB. Two startable QBs > one elite WR if you would otherwise stream junk.
Half-PPR: WRs hold value. Committee RBs are discounted unless they have a path to 15+ touches.
10-team benches are shallow. A 4th RB is worth less than in 12-team. Do not overpay for depth.
Side getting the best player in a 2-for-1 sends extra. 3-for-1s usually lose in 10-team unless you are dumping IR dead.

Never invent a value from vibes. Thin data (Shough, Willis efficiency, Mahomes Thursday sheet, Odunze body part, Love 11-on-11 film, Evans Australia snaps, Kittle snap count) is labeled GUESS or MISSING.
Buy Sunday cut-day risers (Lloyd, Price, Etienne, Allgeier, Stevenson) from managers who drafted before 8/30.
Sell Jacobs for any startable piece. Do not buy Conner/Dell/Tyson/Blue/Benson/Tillman/Milton/Levis/Pacheco/Slayton as discount IR, FA, or practice-squad upside.
